findings.detail: Current W01 committed migration source contains the existing Payload baseline migration only. The approved AUTH-002 extension migration is contracted but has no committed additive migration source.
The previously generated Payload migration artifact recreates existing Payload tables and therefore cannot be admitted as an additive second migration.
Current migration governance requires generation from the frozen W01 configuration and approved contract input and explicitly rejects hand-authoring DDL.
Introducing a Payload collection solely to force generation would create a new persisted authority and is not justified by the current contract.

requiredDecision: Explicitly admit a deterministic generation path for the contracted auth_session_state extension without creating a second business/session authority and without hand-authored DDL.
forbiddenActions: add duplicate sessions collection/table merely to obtain generated SQL
change canonical AUTH-002 contract by inference
apply remote D1 migration before the generation path is admitted and reviewed
antiLoop: Reuse this audit until the W01 migration source, AUTH-002 migration contract, or approved generation path changes.
